note: Glyph outlines traced by kernel/text.mjs glyphCoverageToContours from a real browser coverage raster. Banked so the text gates are deterministic on every machine and need no browser. Coordinates are EM units, glyph origin at (0,0) on the baseline, y up; each contour is a closed ring stored WITHOUT repeating its start, as a flat [x0,y0,x1,y1,...] array.
